Called after a week of fighting a chest infection to be told to call back at 8 and 8.30 because that’s apparently the time to call if your ill?  I said ok thanks for your help I will have to wait and call out of hours this evening because I could hardly breathe. Only at this point the receptionist said ok ok don’t do that I will go a different route. . Nurse called back within 5 mins.
Prescribed steroids and antibiotics no check up but better than nothing. 4 days later no better so called again this time 8.30. Got an appointment with a nurse never seen her before. Explained the antibiotics prescribed were having no affect. She disagreed and gave me more of the same. That nigh felt progressively worse so had to phone 111.
The care I received from the oaks was amazing.
She could not understand why I’d been given more of the same tablets or not had a swab taken. I was prescribed different antibiotics and 2 weeks more of steroids and she could not have been nicer or more caring unlike the rude obnoxious response you get from Linkwood. She even said if at all you feel worse come straight here and checked I had enough pain relief and inhalers. Linkwood need to get things sorted and it you don’t care then get out of the job patients should not be treated like cattle.
No wonder things are missed and some folk just don’t even bother going to you because of the hastle it takes to even get an appointment.
